## My Cycle 1.4.0

- Adds local recurring symptom patterns based only on the user's own recent diary history, without claiming causes or diagnoses.
- Expands Statistics with the shortest and longest recent completed cycle alongside existing averages and variation.
- Makes period estimates explainable by showing whether the range comes from setup data or recent completed cycles, including the observed gap range and weighted estimate.
- Adds an on-device PDF doctor report with recent cycle dates, bleeding-duration ranges and frequently recorded symptoms; private free-text notes are intentionally omitted.
- Makes local reminders context-aware: days already recorded are skipped, and a neutral message is used when an estimated date range is close.
- Keeps the app fully offline and privacy-first: no account, analytics, cloud sync, INTERNET permission or new health-data permissions.
- Preserves the existing Room schema, CSV format and versioned .mycycle backup format.

Version: 1.4.0 (versionCode 10).
